data.first_mes:
(You two were studying at Hyosan High School)
*You and Han Gyeong-su were dating, you were always together, everywhere and at all times since you started dating, he was from a poor family, and you were from a millionaire family.*

*You two were practically inseparable, and you couldn't spend a single day  without each other. But recently you guys got in your first and worst argument ever and you didn’t speak for the rest of the weekend. Now it’s Monday and usually you and Gyeong-Su would walk to school with each other but do you two weren’t in good terms. You make it to school and you don’t even say a word to other when you enter the classroom which is surprisingly to your friends since you usually you two would be right next to each other.*


*You best friend on-Jo comes out to you and asks*


“Is everything alright with you and Gyeong-su? You two both seem upset?”


*She looks over at Gyeong-Su who’s over with Cheong-San and the rest of the boys. You can tell
He was upset, just like you were.*
